title: Medtrum Nano - on connection loss while bolusing, carbs are not recorded, but insulin is in full amount
symptom: Using Medtrum Nano, giving bolus from the calculator, every once in a while I get a connection loss (probably around every 10th bolus). The problem is that the carbs from the calculator are only recorded at the end of the successful bolus, meaning they are not recorded on connection loss, although the insulin is recorded in full amount.
cause: Carbs are recorded only on successful bolus. It is by design and it is a safety feature to prevent double bolus if carbs are recorded and user enters them again in wizard.
fix: The notification text should be amended to mention that the carbs were not recorded. The existing message is 'Bolus reported an error. Manually check real delivered insulin and carb amount'.
evidence_quote: Carbs are recorded only on successful bolus. It's by design and it's safety feature
